mapper.insert: insert into employee (name, username, password, phone, sex, id_number, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{name}, #{username}, #{password}, #{phone}, #{sex}, #{idNumber}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser});
mapper.select:
select id, name, username, phone, id_number, status, update_time from employee
name like CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
select id, name, username, phone, sex, id_number from employee where id = #{id}
mapper.update:
update employee
name = #{name},
phone = #{phone},
sex = #{sex},
id_number = #{idNumber},
status = #{status},
update_time = #{updateTime}, update_user = #{updateUser}
where id = #{id};
update employee set status = #{status} where id = #{id};
